objective: Review and verify integrated A3.1–A3.3 against the accepted contract, then close phase evidence and point the registry to A4.1.
steps: Review integrated A3.1–A3.3 source and evidence against the track plan, test matrix, ADR-0011 and exact pinned Kairos revision.
Run locked workspace tests, workspace Clippy with warnings denied, Rust formatting, and Conductor integrity checks.
Record reviewer-agent findings, exact reviewed HEAD, commands, toolchain, source hashes, outcomes and exclusions.
If findings arise, fix them and repeat applicable review/checks before phase acceptance.
Mark A3.4 accepted and A4.1 next in plan, registries, current state and generated task catalog.

verification.oracle: All parent and pinned Kairos workspace tests and doc-tests pass.
Workspace targets pass Clippy with warnings denied.
Generated task catalog has complete coverage, valid prerequisites and acyclic DAG.
Conductor context and local links validate.
MVP parent/leaf joins and context hashes validate.
No whitespace errors in phase changes.

acceptance: Independent reviewer-agent/subagent examined exact integrated HEAD and reported no open findings or all fixes were re-reviewed.
Workspace/runtime and integrity commands above pass; exact outputs and hashes are recorded.
ADR-0011 boundaries remain explicit; no clinical eligibility, atomic multi-resource grant or portable checkpoint claim.
No ED schema/runtime source, Kairos source or parent pin changes.
A4.1 is the next incomplete task after closeout.
stop_conditions: Out-of-scope source or pin change appears
size_exception: Coordinator-only phase closeout: one evidence receipt plus the existing plan/index/registry/current-state/task-catalog join must be atomic to keep the accepted phase and next-task pointers consistent. The 7 checks are phase-level integration and repository integrity gates; no worker code implementation is authorized.
